title: Chapter titles containing tabs disappear after catalog restoration
symptom: A TXT heading such as 第1章<TAB>开始 is recognized on import, but its chapter is absent after persisting and restoring the catalog.
root_cause: ImportedBookStorage writes the chapter title into TSV after replacing only newlines. restoreBookSnapshot splits on tabs and silently drops records with other than five columns. The parser preserves internal heading tabs.
fix: Read the first TSV field as index, the last three as offsets/count, and join middle fields as the legacy title.
Validate count, indices and ordered ranges; isolate a broken book instead of silently dropping rows. Keep valid old files unchanged.

ImportedBookCatalogRestoreTest covers a directly written legacy TAB fixture, nonzero progress, unchanged bytes and a broken neighboring catalog. Targeted JVM regressions and the nine-book production import/restore corpus passed on 2026-09-11.
impact: Legacy TAB titles and chapter bodies survive disk catalog reload without rewriting old catalogs or reparsing their TXT. Android host process-restart evidence is tracked separately in the phase-one plan.
